title: PROP-141 approved: Phase 1 operator-applied (commit 665dcf49). Implement Phase 2 (registration-gap lint) and close ISS-3011.

context.what_landed: Operator approved PROP-141 and applied Phase 1 in commit 665dcf49 (2026-07-25): all 10 monitor/baseline/*.txt now registered git-owned in build.js OWNERSHIP + workspace-sync.md NEVER_PUSH + CLAUDE.md. This closes the STRUCTURAL cause of ISS-3011 — future baseline reseeds now propagate git->FUSE. tinker's 2026-07-25T02-40 interim data backfill remains the reason the current FUSE copies are already correct.
context.why_operator_did_phase_1: PROP-141 Phase 1 targets three NEVER_PUSH files, so it cannot be agent-pushed (PROP-016 Mech A would strand it, exactly as ISS-3001 was stranded). Operator direct-push was the only path. Phase 2 is different — it is code/prompt authoring tinker can do and push normally.

part_A_phase_2_lint.what: Implement PROP-141 Phase 2 (Option C): a read-only registration-gap lint that flags files which (a) were modified in git by agent-clone commits in the last N days, (b) exist on FUSE, and (c) appear in NEITHER build.js OWNERSHIP nor workspace-sync.md NEVER_PUSH nor an append-only walked directory. Emit a moderate 'ownership-registration-gap' finding. Add to structure-integrity.md as a daily read-only check.
part_A_phase_2_lint.rationale: Three instances of this exact defect class in one month (ISS-3000 check-wayback.js, ISS-3001 clone-hygiene.sh, ISS-3011 monitor/baseline/) justify turning it into an auto-detected canary. The allow-list covers the deliberately-unclassified multi-writer files per CLAUDE.md.
part_A_phase_2_lint.note: Standard tinker implementation path (author as a PROP phase or self-apply per your normal flow). structure-integrity.md is a NEVER_PUSH prompt file — if you cannot push it, strand per Mech A and the operator will apply, same as Phase 1. Flag in your summary if so.

part_B_close_iss_3011.action: Verify PROP-141 Phase 1 is present in HEAD (run the PROP-141 verification_pattern: build.js has 10 monitor/baseline entries AND workspace-sync.md has 10) — commit 665dcf49 — then close ISS-3011 (currently assigned-tinker) citing that commit. PROP-141 notes_for_implementer: 'ISS-3011 should be closed when Phase 1 lands.' It has landed.
part_B_close_iss_3011.note: ISS-3012 is a SEPARATE assigned-tinker item (priority-queue lint hardening) and is NOT covered by PROP-141 or this directive — leave it for its own Mode 0 pass.
